Glendale pickups, from Catlin Court to Arrowhead and Norterra

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Glendale is the West Valley’s event city. State Farm Stadium and the entertainment district beside it pull crowds from the whole metro, and Arrowhead, Historic Downtown and Catlin Court, and the Deer Valley and Norterra side north of the city fill in the rest of the map.

How we work in Glendale

Nothing exposes a transport plan like a stadium night in Glendale. Lots fill hours before kickoff, the exit crawls afterwards, and a group scattered across three rideshares does not leave together. A chauffeured party bus parks the problem: one drop at the district, one pickup point afterwards, and the group stays whole.

Where we pick up in Glendale

We pick up across Downtown Glendale and Catlin Court, Central Glendale, West Glendale around the stadium district, North Glendale through Arrowhead and Arrowhead Ranch, and out to Deer Valley and Norterra. The same coverage carries across the wider West Valley toward the Peoria border.

What a booking costs in Glendale

The fleet seats 6 to 56. Below are the Sprinters first, then the group end, each with the rate, the minimum, what that minimum comes to and the per-person figure the pricing page publishes for the same vehicle, on the same basis. The full grid is on the pricing page, and it is the same grid in Glendale as everywhere else we serve.

An hourly charter carries a 4-hour minimum on every listed vehicle, and a 5-hour minimum on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. A point-to-point transfer has no hourly minimum at all: it is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off, and a longer transfer is priced from the drive with the empty return included, with the basis shown on the quote.

What you pay at checkout depends on the method you choose. Some methods take a 50% deposit and charge the balance to that same method no earlier than 48 hours before pickup; others settle in full at checkout and leave nothing due before the ride. Checkout says which applies to yours before you confirm.

Cancellation is decided by the date first. An ordinary date refunds in full 14 or more days ahead; a reservation of 20 or more passengers or 2 or more vehicles refunds in full 30 or more days ahead, with the deposit kept from there in to 14 days; and a major-event date overrides both — its deposit is not refundable and the balance returns only 60 or more days ahead.

Added at the end: 8% Arizona tax, and nothing else — no booking fee and no fuel fee. A promotion code is capped at 10%. Gratuity is optional and is never added for you. Taking the return leg together with the outbound takes 20% off the return leg. An added stop is $50 on a transfer or a round trip and is complimentary on an hourly charter.

Frequently asked questions

Do you run game days and concerts at the stadium district?

Yes. We drop the group at the district before the crowd, hold the vehicle for the hours you book, and collect at an agreed point away from the main exit crush rather than in it.

Do you cover the rest of the West Valley?

Yes. Glendale is the page for the West Valley generally — Arrowhead, the Peoria border, Deer Valley and Norterra are all normal pickups, and the reservations team will confirm any address further west before you pay.

Can we drink on board on the way to a game?

Passengers 21 and over may drink on board a vehicle for hire in Arizona. It is bring-your-own, nobody under 21 drinks, and the chauffeur never does.

How long should we book for a stadium night?

Long enough to cover the wait. Party buses carry a four-hour minimum, and most stadium groups book longer so the vehicle is still there when the exit finally clears.

Is there a minimum on a Glendale booking?

An hourly charter carries a 4-hour minimum on every listed vehicle, and a 5-hour minimum on the 56-passenger motorcoach. A point-to-point transfer is priced as a trip instead and carries no hourly minimum at all; the section above sets out how a transfer is priced.

Is a Glendale pickup priced differently from a Scottsdale one?

No — one published grid covers every city we serve, so a vehicle costs what the grid says wherever it collects, and there is no zone, city or district surcharge. Distance is separate from the rate: a point-to-point transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off and is priced from the drive beyond that, with the empty return included.

What holds the date?

A payment at checkout. Some methods take a 50% deposit and charge the balance to that same method before pickup; others settle in full at checkout and leave nothing due before the ride. Checkout says which applies to yours before you confirm.

What happens if we cancel?

The date decides it first. An ordinary date refunds in full 14 or more days ahead; a reservation of 20 or more passengers or 2 or more vehicles, 30 or more days ahead; and a major-event date overrides both, with the deposit non-refundable and the balance returned only 60 or more days ahead.

What gets added at checkout?

Arizona tax at 8%, and nothing else — there is no booking fee and no fuel fee. A promotion code is capped at 10%. Gratuity is optional and is never added for you. Taking the return leg together with the outbound takes 20% off the return leg, and an added stop is complimentary on an hourly charter.
